items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that is gentle enough for a first face-washing habit.
A mineral SPF 50 for mornings keeps daily sun protection simple and easy on young skin.

response.routine_note: Wash your face gently with lukewarm water once or twice a day, and apply sunscreen in the morning before going outside. Skip scrubs, acids and anti-aging products at this age, and ask a parent or a dermatologist if you have any concerns about your skin.
